g.text: SmartFix: Class Diagram (backend design, event-driven modules)
+subscribe(queue: String, events: List<String>, consumer: EventConsumer): void
+recordDeadLetter(eventId: UUID, consumer: AppModule, error: String): void
parse -> open tx with SET LOCAL app.module
-> handle() -> commit -> publish new events -> ack.
On error: nack; after 3 tries -> dead letter (NFR-3).
